review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC3978353, Recognition Strategies of Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cells
primary_title: ROR-gamma-t-positive innate lymphoid cells regulate intestinal homeostasis by integrating negative signals from the symbiotic microbiota
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Sawa primary showing that epithelial IL-25 induced by symbiotic microbiota represses IL-22 production by intestinal ROR-gamma-t-positive innate lymphoid cells, with the effect restored after epithelial damage.
limitations_preserved: Inhibitory functional bridge only; preserve epithelial IL-25, microbiota/homeostatic and mouse intestinal ILC context, and do not upgrade to a direct IL-25-IL17RB receptor mechanism, a specific dendritic-cell intermediate, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.
